input.summary:
Integration pass: opened a 2-wide doorway from the council chamber into the clock room (shell.mjs), so the clock room now walks in; added 10 lamp posts on the side lawns and rear garden (grounds.mjs), so outdoor floor light went from 312 dark cells to 0 and every room is lit at 8+. make.sh passes; check shows 0 floating blocks.
The Belfry is still "UNREACHABLE: no way in": its only access is the 21-block ladder up the 3×3 tower, which the walker does not climb, and no stair fits in that shaft.
Clerk's office and Committee room west have a few standable cells on top of a lantern and bookshelves, but both rooms verdict ok.
left: Belfry (box x19..21 y32..34 z11..13) fails walk: the only way up is the ladder at x21 z13 y4..31, which the walker treats as passable but never climbs; the tower interior is 3x3 so a stair from the clock room (y11) to the belfry (y32) would need a spiral of about 21 risers through the clock works and lectern. Decision needed: accept the ladder as the belfry access (in-game it works), add a spiral stair (rebuild room-10 and the shell's tower), or teach the walker to climb ladders.
The Mayor's office inside view shows a dark blue object near the lower-left floor edge, which I did not identify; it may be a flagpole banner seen through a window, not verified.
Eight oak_leaves tips at the garden oak crowns (x5/11 and x29/35, z29..35) are reported as orphans. They are crown tips with one leaf neighbour, so harmless, but the check flags them.

Clerk's office cell (9,6,24) and Committee room west cells (17,13,12) and (17,13,13) are standable cells on top of a lantern and bookshelves; they are not floor cells and the rooms verdict ok, so I left them.

waste.tool: mcd walk should report the blocking cause per room (for example: 'reachable only by ladder at x21 z13; walker does not climb ladders', or 'the wall at z14 separates this room from the council chamber') and suggest the wall cell to open.

waste.what: Chose the lamp spots for the side lawns and rear garden by reading the dark-cell map and placing posts by eye.
waste.cost: one edit plus two light runs to confirm; the search was done by eye across a 41x37 site map
waste.tool: mcd light --y <y> --suggest should list lamp positions (lampPost x,z) that clear the dark cells, the way room --suggest lamp spots does for rooms.

waste.what: Checked each room's unreached cells against the furniture by reading the room modules to see whether they were floor or pockets above furniture.
waste.tool: mcd walk should tag an unreached standable cell as 'on top of furniture' or 'pocket' when the cell below is furniture, so it isn't mistaken for a blocked floor.

waste.what: Confirmed the orphan oak leaves and standable-over-furniture cells by reading sources and the room layout.
waste.tool: mcd check should separate tree-crown tips (leaves with one leaf neighbour) from real orphans, so the report stops listing them as problems.

companions.task: Place the outdoor lamp posts and check the rear garden and side lawns at dusk, and tell me if the posts need to move so the garden paths read well at street level.

Decide whether the belfry can take a spiral stair inside the 3x3 tower (clock works, lectern and chain are in the way) or whether the ladder should stay as the only way up; if a stair, lay it out on paper first with the clock room's furniture moved.
